name: Etapp 10: Kolarmoraån to Gimo / Gimo herrgård
utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include shelter, toilet, fireplace, rest area, water, heritage.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Do not merge Etapp 9, Etapp 11, removed Risingeslingan geometry, access offsets or side facilities into Etapp 10.
Official August 2025 Naturkartan warning remains active: neglected maintenance, fallen trees/brush, recommendation to choose another stage and partial reroute planned along Kolarmoraån.
Iteration 3: official August 2025 condition warning is still active on Naturkartan; no separate updated reroute/GPX replacement found.
Iteration 3: >500 m gaps are internal to track 5, not segment boundaries, so renderer must split on gap threshold or insert explicit breaks.
